Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format and present the various sections by following the example provided there.

Input
* Please rewrite this section by following the example. Include the line number, variable name ([[text]]), variable type and variable description.

Output
* Please rewrite this section by following the example. Include the line number, output type and description.

* Please move the final constraint into this section. Then format "no things to see here" as a {{constant}} and remove the quotation marks.

* Should the output phrase use "no" or "No"? Please ensure consistent capitalisation.

Constraints
* Please format both instances of "text" as a [[variable]].

* Please change 1000 to 10, as no input strings are longer than 10 characters.

* Please remove the 3rd constraint.

Stub generator
* Please change 1000 to 10.

* Why "write payments"? Please replace "payments" with "answer".

Game modes
* The task may be too difficult to infer from the visible cases alone in Reverse mode. Consider disabling this mode.

Cases
* These cases are the same:
  • Test 3 and Validator 3
  • Test 4 and Validator 4

  Please revise the cases so that each test and its corresponding validator cover the same scenario but use slightly different inputs and outputs.

  Please also ensure that all digits appear in at least one test and at least one validator.

Thanks.

✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: its simple and easy
